note: Map of device types and building blocks: what has a surrogate, what is planned, what is open. Edit this file, then run `python tools/make_coverage.py` (writes docs/COVERAGE.md and web/coverage.json). A device with a family_id must be registered in families.json.

device_status.surrogate: registered family with published data and weights
device_status.planned: on the roadmap; no data yet
device_status.experiment: exploratory work outside the registry; no published model

block_status.learned: block model fitted to solver data and checked on held-out solves
block_status.experiment: block solved or fitted in an experiment; not published
block_status.none: no usable closed form; needs solver data

routes.family: fixed topology, parameter vector in, S-parameters out (prior + learned correction)
routes.compose: building blocks joined by network theory, plus a small learned correction for the device
routes.grid: pixel or polygon layout in, inside one footprint and stackup (needs 10^4-10^5 solves in published work)

blocks.label: Uniform line
blocks.desc: Microstrip line of width w and length l. Closed form: Hammerstad-Jensen with Kirschning-Jansen dispersion; checked against Palace in the low-pass composition experiment.

blocks.label: Open end
blocks.desc: Fringing at an open line end, as an extra length (Hammerstad, Kirschning).

blocks.label: Radial stub
blocks.desc: Fan-shaped open stub for wide-band shunt capacitance. Approximate closed forms only.

blocks.label: CPW line
blocks.desc: Coplanar waveguide line, with or without a bottom ground. Conformal-mapping formulas.

blocks.label: Width step
blocks.desc: Change of line width w_a to w_b. Closed forms are valid only for small width ratios; a Palace-solved step is in the low-pass composition experiment.

blocks.label: Mitred bend
blocks.desc: 90 degree bend with a mitre. Approximate closed forms.

blocks.label: U-bend
blocks.desc: 180 degree turn of a hairpin resonator; the two arms couple across it.

blocks.label: T-junction
blocks.desc: Three-port junction (stubs, tapped feeds, power splits). Closed forms lose accuracy at high frequency.

blocks.label: Cross junction
blocks.desc: Four-port junction (double stubs). Approximate closed forms.

blocks.label: Series gap
blocks.desc: Small gap between two collinear lines (end-coupled resonators, DC blocks).

blocks.label: Coupled-line pair
blocks.desc: Two parallel lines, even and odd modes (Kirschning-Jansen). Part of the analytic prior of edge_coupled_bpf.

blocks.label: N-conductor lines
blocks.desc: N parallel lines as one block (multiconductor line). Includes coupling between non-adjacent lines; per-unit-length L and C from 2D cross-section solves. Planned in the composition experiment.

blocks.label: Interdigital cap.
blocks.desc: Interleaved fingers as a series capacitor. Approximate closed forms.

blocks.label: Via
blocks.desc: Plated hole to ground or between layers, with its pads. Closed forms for the inductance only.

blocks.label: Air bridge / wire
blocks.desc: Bond wire or air bridge that crosses other conductors (Lange fingers, spiral underpass).

blocks.label: Component pad
blocks.desc: Pads and the parasitic of a soldered chip resistor or capacitor.

blocks.label: Spiral winding
blocks.desc: Planar spiral turns. Closed forms (modified Wheeler, current sheet) give the inductance, not the self-resonance.

blocks.label: SIW section
blocks.desc: Substrate-integrated waveguide between two via rows. Equivalent-width formulas.

blocks.label: Patch radiator
blocks.desc: Radiating patch. Cavity and transmission-line models give resonance and input impedance approximately.

blocks.label: Coax launch
blocks.desc: Edge or vertical connector to a planar line. Depends on the connector part.

devices.label: Edge-coupled BPF
devices.desc: Parallel-coupled microstrip band-pass filter, Chebyshev N = 3, RO4350B, 3-7 GHz.

devices.label: Hairpin BPF
devices.desc: Folded half-wave resonators. Second family on the roadmap (v0.2).

related.why: also needs coupling between non-adjacent resonators

devices.label: Stepped-impedance LPF
devices.desc: Alternating high- and low-impedance sections (series L, shunt C). Test case for building blocks joined by network theory.

related.why: same response, stubs instead of wide sections

devices.label: Open-stub LPF
devices.desc: Low-pass filter with open shunt stubs (Richards' transformation, Kuroda identities).

devices.label: Stub band-stop
devices.desc: Quarter-wave open stubs on a through line.

devices.label: Interdigital BPF
devices.desc: Quarter-wave resonators grounded at alternate ends.

devices.label: Combline BPF
devices.desc: Short-circuited resonators with loading capacitors at the open ends.

devices.label: Open-loop resonator BPF
devices.desc: Square open-loop resonators with cross coupling and transmission zeros.

devices.label: SIW cavity filter
devices.desc: Cavities in substrate-integrated waveguide, coupled through via-post irises.

devices.label: Pixelated filter
devices.desc: Free metal pattern on a pixel grid. No decomposition into blocks; needs a grid model and many solves.

devices.label: Branch-line coupler
devices.desc: 90 degree hybrid from four quarter-wave lines.

devices.label: Rat-race coupler
devices.desc: 180 degree hybrid ring, 1.5 wavelengths around.

devices.label: Coupled-line coupler
devices.desc: Quarter-wave coupled section, backward coupling.

devices.label: Lange coupler
devices.desc: Interdigitated fingers with bond wires for tight (3 dB) coupling.

devices.label: Wilkinson divider
devices.desc: Equal-split divider with an isolation resistor.

devices.label: Marchand balun
devices.desc: Two coupled quarter-wave sections; single-ended to differential.

devices.label: Quarter-wave transformer
devices.desc: One or more quarter-wave sections between two impedances.

devices.label: Stub match
devices.desc: Single or double shunt-stub matching network.

devices.label: Tapered line
devices.desc: Exponential or Klopfenstein taper, as many short line sections.

devices.label: Microstrip-CPW transition
devices.desc: Probe-pad or coplanar-to-microstrip transition with ground vias.

devices.label: Layer-to-layer via
devices.desc: Signal via between layers with return vias and anti-pads.

devices.label: Connector launch
devices.desc: Coaxial connector to microstrip or CPW. One family per connector part.

devices.label: Spiral inductor
devices.desc: On-chip or PCB spiral with an underpass.

devices.label: Planar transformer
devices.desc: Interleaved or stacked windings, also used as baluns.

devices.label: Interdigital capacitor
devices.desc: Series capacitor from interleaved fingers.

devices.label: Inset-fed patch
devices.desc: Rectangular patch fed by an inset microstrip line. Needs far-field outputs in the data contract.

devices.label: Patch array 2x2
devices.desc: Four patches with a corporate feed. Mutual coupling between patches is the residual.

devices.label: Printed dipole
devices.desc: Printed dipole with a feed balun.

devices.label: Vivaldi
devices.desc: Tapered-slot antenna. No useful decomposition into blocks.

devices.label: Ring resonator
devices.desc: Gap-coupled ring, used for substrate characterisation.

devices.label: MRI birdcage coil
devices.desc: Volume coil from rungs and capacitor-loaded end rings. 3D; field outputs needed.
